images.title: 2 km 700 m plus 1 km 800 m in two columns
images.purpose: Show adding two lengths in a km column and a m column with a carry: 2 km 700 m + 1 km 800 m = 4 km 500 m.
images.composition: A small table with two columns, km and m, two rows, a carry chip above the km column and the total row below a line.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TABLE: two columns headed km (x 428 to 728) and m (x 728 to 1028), each header a teal #0072B2 rounded box 300 by 60 px (y 130 to 190) with the unit text in white 44 px. ROWS in 72 px bold dark text, each number centred in its column: first row at y 280 with 2 under km and 700 under m; second row at y 380 with 1 under km and 800 under m, and a plus sign + at x 340, y 380; one thick dark horizontal line from x 380 to x 1076 at y 440; total row at y 530 with 4 under km and 500 under m. CARRY: one amber #E69F00 circle 70 px across at x 578, y 215 above the km column with the digit 1 inside, and one curved arrow from the m total (x 878, y 480) up to the circle. Beside the table at the right, x 1100 to 1400, three lines of 40 px text: 700 m + 800 m = 1,500 m, 1,500 m = 1 km 500 m, 3 km + 1 km 500 m = 4 km 500 m. In all: 1 table, 2 columns, 3 number rows, 1 carry circle. All shapes are flat fills with thin dark #2B2B2B outlines (3 px), no shadows and no gradients; all text is dark #1F2937 sans-serif. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Add like units, then carry 1,000 m as 1 km.
images.description: A km column and a m column with 2 km 700 m plus 1 km 800 m, a carried 1 km and the total 4 km 500 m.
images.context: Concept image for Adding Lengths. It follows the idea of the column method for Saji's walk in your maths book (km and m columns with a carry) and shows the concept's own example, 2 km 700 m + 1 km 800 m (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Add the m column first and show the carry. The slip to watch: writing 1,500 in the m column.
